name: Hayven Celestia: Under One Sky
source:
"Hayven Celestia: Under One Sky" is a Sci-fi Visual Novel following Sera, a hotshot pilot and the planet's best defense against the evil Krakun empire. But you can't do it alone. An adventure this dangerous is gonna require the cooperation of both friend... and foe.

Help Sera travel to the neighboring planets and form an alliance capable of taking out the dreadnought that threatens his home. Play games of diplomacy! Not all cultures are the same, what works for one planet isn't guaranteed to work for another. Be careful! 

Time is of the essence. The Lio are counting on you!

[From [url=https://millerdark.itch.io/under-one-sky]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《海文·塞拉斯蒂娅：天空之下》是一部科幻视觉小说，讲述了塞拉的故事，塞拉是一名热门飞行员，也是地球上对抗邪恶克拉昆帝国的最佳防御者。但你不能独自做到这一点。如此危险的冒险需要朋友和敌人的合作。

帮助塞拉前往邻近的行星并组建一个联盟，能够消灭威胁他家园的无畏舰。玩外交游戏！并非所有文化都是相同的，适用于一个星球的文化并不一定适用于另一个星球。当心！

时间至关重要。里奥人就指望你了！

[来自[url=https://millerdark.itch.io/under-one-sky]itch.io[/url]]
